videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Okafor the difference despite Van Hecke defiance - Leeds v Spurs ratings.
How Leeds United and Tottenham Hotspurs' players rated in their Premier League match.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

I left Man City for my mental wellbeing - Trafford.
James Trafford says not playing for Manchester City last season was "horrendous" and left him with no choice but to leave the club and join Leeds United in the summer.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Non-league's greatest giant-killers eye another scalp.
Non-league Altrincham aim to make Notts County number 18 on their list of FA Cup scalps, and breathe new life into their tag of English football's ultimate giant-killers.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

My dream is to win Ballon d'Or - Gabriel.
Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel says his "dream is to win the Ballon d'Or", as he closes in on a move to Real Madrid.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Scotland lose Welsh and call up Porteous.
Swansea City centre-back Stephen Welsh drops out the Scotland squad for their forthcoming Nations League double-header and is replaced with Los Angeles' Ryan Porteous.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Actualidad internacional.

England 'disappointment' fuels Dewsbury-Hall's Everton heroics.
Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall responds to his England omission by scoring a stunning goal to inspire Everton's 3-1 comeback victory over Coventry City.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

How 'calm' Eustace got the result he needed for Derby.
How under-pressure John Eustace kept calm to ensure he would carry on as Rams boss by overseeing Friday's come-from-behind win over Bolton.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

'A beautiful story' as Bellingham brothers called up.
It may be a surprise to some but Jobe Bellingham's call up to the England senior side has been a long time coming.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Is Palmer's England career over under Tuchel?.
Cole Palmer faces a fight to save his England career after he was excluded from Thomas Tuchel's latest squad, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Real Madrid and PSG keen on Suzuki - Saturday's gossip.
Paris St-Germain and Real Madrid interested in Aston Villa keeper Zion Suzuki, Inter Milan weighing up move for Crystal Palace's Chris Richards, plus more.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Can we play you every week? The day Southend toppled Man United.
Southend United's heroes remember their famous victory against Manchester United 20 years on.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Football Daily.
Trafford or Pickford? Why did James leave Man City? And why choose Leeds United?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

I had to play regularly for my mental wellbeing - Trafford on summer move.
Leeds United's James Trafford opens up on his struggles at Manchester City last season that were behind his summer transfer.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Barry scores twice as Everton fight back to beat Coventry.
In-form Thierno Barry scores twice as Everton came from behind to beat Coventry as the Toffees move into fifth in the Premier League table.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Leicester hold nerve to knock out sixth-tier Oxford City.
League One side, and 2021 champions, Leicester City avoid an upset as they beat sixth-tier Oxford City 4-2 at the MGroup Stadium, to reach the second round of the FA Cup.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
